The result is a live visualization of the electromagnetic environment surrounding Earth — and the rest of the solar system.</p>
      <p class="sw-prose">Every particle field, every magnetic field line, every CME trajectory is drawn from actual simulation and observation data. This is the same data space weather forecasters use, made navigable.</p>

        <p class="sw-card-desc">One of the most powerful solar storms of Solar Cycle 23 — an X5.7 flare and fast CME that triggered a severe geomagnetic storm, disrupted satellites, and produced aurora visible as far south as Texas and the Mediterranean. OpenSpace recreates the full event using ENLIL simulation data from NASA CCMC.</p>
